verdict.rationale: Orama's docs state that every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server that is automatically configured to interact with the project's data. Agents in ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI interfaces can therefore use the indexes as a tool, and a probe confirms the MCP server docs page exists. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP tools cover analytics and index/write operations beyond querying, a documented list of the MCP tools, the MCP server being available outside Orama Cloud (i.e. for the open-source library), and independent hands-on corroboration.
